correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the first uniform feasible edge gives an exact recurrence. The path and (2,2,L)-spider deletion recurrences yield d_L=μ(S)-μ(P), (L+4)d_L=(L+3)d_(L−1)+d_(L−2)+b_L with b_L=2(-2)^(L−2)(L²+3L−2)/(L!(L+1)(L+2)). For L>=2 its signs alternate and magnitudes strictly decrease, forcing all d_L>0 by induction. Exact independent Prüfer enumeration of n^(n−2) labeled trees and ordered proper shifts returned (negative,zero,positive) counts (24,0,0) at n=4, (480,0,0) at n=5, (6180,2160,0) at n=6; direct recurrence verifies μ(P7)=26/9 and μ(S222)=3. The infinite proof is analytic, finite census certifies only the stated cutoff.
